name: HeidiSQL
description: The source directly supports a narrow primary C observation: the update path uses HTTPS/application download code as configured elsewhere, but the inspected payload checks are existence and a minimum-size threshold; no hash or signature check appears before the updater copies the downloaded executable over the application.
limitations: Newly retrieved snapshot at the recorded commit, not historical release verification.
The cited source does not establish the URL scheme/TLS policy inside THttpDownload or the release metadata source.
The embedded updater is a native executable represented by a retained binary plus source; only the Pascal control flow was inspected.
